description:
## Problem
A user starting TPC data or query generation at a large scale cannot tell how long it will take. Estimates exist today but are not measured for generation: the interactive prompt scales a per-benchmark minutes range by `(0.5 + 0.5 * scale)` (cli/benchmarks.py:708-711) and the dry run shows estimates (cli/dryrun.py:276-278,737-738).

## Change
1. Measurement runs, approved by the owner, on this Mac, one at a time through `make heavy-run`, each recording wall time and peak memory: `dsqgen` all 99 queries, timed per query, at SF 1, 100, 1000, 3000, 5000; `dsdgen` full generation at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10; `dbgen` full generation at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10. Run folders under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs are kept.
2. Bring the table to the owner.
3. After the owner has seen it: print an estimate before generation, labelled rough, naming the scales and host class it was measured on, and marking any scale above the measured ones as extrapolated. Say in the pull request how it relates to the two existing estimates (replace or feed them; one convention, not a third).
4. A run warns when its run limit is shorter than the estimate; no warning when no limit is set or the limit is larger.

## Decision gates
Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message stating a limit, or label text the owner has not already chosen is shown to the owner before it is committed. No estimate figure is committed before the owner has seen the table. Known so far, darwin-arm64 only: dsqgen query 9 about 5 s at SF 3000 and 11 to 13 s at SF 5000. If a measurement run is refused admission or would breach the disk floor, stop and report; do not shrink the list silently.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the measured table is recorded here with heavy-run log paths and the owner's acknowledgement; tests show the printed estimate for a measured scale lies within the measured range and that an unmeasured scale is labelled extrapolated; tests show the warning when the limit is below the estimate and none when it is unset or above; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking; `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job that never ran or was cancelled by the runner, never for a test that failed. Review threads: reply, and resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text the owner has not already chosen is shown to the owner before it is committed. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment. A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`.
